name: scripture-trails
description: Clear, context-aware Bible answers with meaningful Scripture connections and responsible conversational discovery.

interface.longDescription: Get clear, conversational answers grounded in each passage's original literary and historical context. Explore historical and cultural background, follow meaningful Scripture connections, and consider language details with care. Scripture Trails distinguishes explicit textual evidence from interpretation, acknowledges uncertainty, and avoids prescribing doctrinal conclusions.
capabilities: Explore biblical passages with literary and historical context
Compare responsible interpretations with appropriate uncertainty
defaultPrompt: Why did Jesus quote Psalm 22 on the cross?
How does John 1 connect to Genesis 1?
Take me down a meaningful rabbit trail from Jonah.
